Definition: a foot (as used in walking); by implication, a step; by euphemistically the pudenda
BiblicalUsage: 1) foot; 1a) foot, leg; 1b) of God (anthropomorphic); 1c) of seraphim, cherubim, idols, animals, table; 1d) according to the pace of (with prep); 1e) three times (feet, paces)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
